name: Test

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]

    branches: [main]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ['3.9', '3.10', '3.11', '3.12']
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          cache: 'pip'

      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v7
        with:
          version: '0.4.0'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: uv sync --frozen

      - name: Run tests
        run: pytest

  test-generated-project:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        orm: ['tortoise', 'beanie']
        docker: [true, false]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python 3.11
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
          cache: 'pip'

      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v7
        with:
          version: '0.4.0'

      - name: Install cookiecutter
        run: uv add cookiecutter

      - name: Generate project
        run: |
          mkdir -p generated
          cookiecutter . --no-input -o generated \
            --extra-context "project_name=demo,orm=${{ matrix.orm }},docker=${{ matrix.docker }}"

      - name: Verify no unreplaced template variables
        run: |
          if grep -R '{{cookiecutter' generated; then
            echo "Unreplaced template variables found!"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Check Python syntax
        run: |
          find generated -name '*.py' -exec python -m py_compile {} +

      - name: Install generated project dependencies
        run: |
          cd generated/demo
          uv sync --frozen || true

      - name: Basic import test
        run: |
          cd generated/demo
          PACKAGE=$(basename $(pwd))
          python -c "import $PACKAGE"
